visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an exterior shot of a humble street-side restaurant in Kaohsiung, featuring colorful signage and a large metal scaffold above. A male pedestrian walks past the storefront on a paved road under bright, natural daylight. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a food preparation counter where gloved hands are seen efficiently assembling a meal box; white rice, green vegetables, and orange toppings are placed carefully before a generous portion of glazed chicken is ladled in. (3) An older male shop owner wearing a light blue polo shirt, a grey face mask, and glasses is seen working behind the stainless-steel kitchen counter, handling containers and packaging materials with practiced movements. (4) Multiple extreme close-up shots follow, focusing on the textures of the food; pieces of chicken coated in a thick, glossy brown sauce are lifted with a spoon, and chopsticks pick up vibrant green cucumber slices and bright orange cabbage. (5) The final sequence shows the completed boxed meals resting on a surface, followed by a brief shot of the indoor dining area with simple wooden tables and red chairs, before ending on an exterior view of the restaurant's detailed menu board and entrance.
